The meme comes from Block’s Dessa announcement: an AI model trained on human speech rather than text. Our parody turns that into a familiar crypto personality—the person who never reads the whitepaper but has the most to say in Spaces.

“Never read the whitepaper. Still took over the Spaces.” captures the joke immediately. The oversized human mouth on a desktop speaker makes the character recognisable, while the disconnected mute button reinforces its personality: professionally unmuted.

The name, mascot, spoken Yap Archive and personalised yap receipts support one coherent idea. Community members can claim the identity through their own unsolicited opinions, endless voice notes and “so basically…” replies. Every long explanation becomes another opportunity to reuse the meme.

Its strongest contrast is zero reading versus unlimited confidence. That gives it relevance beyond the launch headline and plenty of remix potential.
